name: the great mud rock of the source's north-shore cave (scale 10, some 20 m across) is too big for the space by the plaza: it buried Nolu-Jeel's door; the cave mouth keeps its own nearer rock

before.why: the source's cave mouth in its mud rocks (the Tree-Minders' Hall's door), which stood outside the footprint on the source's north shore: brought whole beside the city tree, where the tree-minders keep it
